mapper.select: SELECT signature_id, owner_type, employee_id, image_path, is_active, is_deleted, created_at FROM signature WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY signature_id DESC
SELECT signature_id, owner_type, employee_id, image_path, is_active, is_deleted, created_at FROM signature WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND is_deleted = 'N' AND is_active = 'Y'
SELECT signature_id, owner_type, employee_id, image_path, is_active, is_deleted, created_at FROM signature WHERE signature_id = #{signatureId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signature (owner_type, employee_id, image_path) VALUES (#{ownerType}, #{employeeId}, #{imagePath})
